name: com.gameframex.unity.systeminfo
description:
GameFrameX SystemInfo — device unique identifier package implemented in pure C# with JNI, requiring no Java or JAR files. Provides DeviceGetOaid (Android), DeviceGetIdfa (iOS), DeviceGetImei, and DeviceUniqueIdentifier, which returns a 32-character MD5 machine fingerprint. Values are stripped of dashes, capped at 32 characters, and cached via PlayerPrefs so system interfaces are not called again after first retrieval. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX SystemInfo — 设备唯一标识符功能包，纯 C# 通过 JNI 实现，无需 Java 或 JAR 文件。提供 DeviceGetOaid（Android）、DeviceGetIdfa（iOS）、DeviceGetImei 与 DeviceUniqueIdentifier（返回 32 位十六进制 MD5 机器码）。取值会去除 - 号并截断到最长 32 位，通过 PlayerPrefs 缓存，首次获取后不再重复调用系统接口。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
